title: b7z9.40(a): Python raw-diag resources require local admin authorization (R-11-030)
description: Child of b7z9.40. spec/11-lci.md 17.5.4 R-11-030: raw diagnostics MUST require local administrative authorization. Evidence: /diag/raw/rx render_put (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/raw_rx.py:45) and /diag/raw/tx render_post (raw_tx.py:41) have NO server-side authz (rg is_local_admin|oscore|admin -> zero hits in the resources); authorization is client-side only (lichen/client/lci.py:240-270 LESC check, bypassable server-side). Wire the existing coap/access.py admin gate into both resources' render methods with tests (authorized admin OK, non-admin rejected). Landable independently of the (b)/(c) siblings.
